test_title: PYST 59: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a car park, vehicle A is to the west of vehicle B. Vehicle C is to the east of vehicle B. Vehicle D is to the north of vehicle B. Vehicle E is to the south of vehicle C. Vehicle F is to the north of vehicle C. What is the position of vehicle E with respect to vehicle A?
solution: **Given:** Vehicle A is to the west of vehicle B. Vehicle C is to the east of vehicle B. Vehicle D is to the north of vehicle B. Vehicle E is to the south of vehicle C. Vehicle F is to the north of vehicle C.
